organizers.name: FAD Market

account.note: Applies each season and is on their list.

organizers.howItWorks: Apply each season. If you withdraw an application, email them to say so. Failing to do that affects future consideration.
organizers.notes: Fall 2026 applications (Brooklyn Heights, Cobble Hill, DUMBO, Greenpoint-Williamsburg) closed Jul 27. Holiday Pop-up applications closed Sep 27, decisions by Oct 13.

organizers.name: Brooklyn Pop-Up (BKPU)
organizers.howItWorks: Every listing on your dashboard's Upcoming Events page is its own application, and Fort Greene Saturdays are listed one date at a time. Listings labeled "FOOD & BEVERAGE VENDORS" are for food and drink makers, not BKSB. Fort Greene deadlines run about 45 days before each Saturday. Acceptances sometimes land in spam, so check the dashboard.
organizers.notes: More holiday markets ("round two") were announced as coming soon.

organizers.name: Artists & Fleas

account.note: Accepted 2026-06-29 for Williamsburg (70 N 7th St), Clothing Design category.

organizers.howItWorks: You are approved as a merchant first, then book individual dates at booking.artistsandfleas.com. Booking is first-to-pay and nonrefundable. Your first booking is limited to one weekend. Fall is Saturday/Sunday only (Fridays closed until the holidays), booking is open through November, and the Rewind weekend rate is $400 through October.

organizers.name: Brooklyn Flea / BQ Flea / Record Fair

account.note: Vendor agreement completed 2026-08-17 (PandaDoc). Pays via Stripe.

organizers.howItWorks: Complete the annual onboarding form (with your signed vendor agreement) before booking. Pay through the link Lena sends. Regular BQ booths were $150 per day, and you can ask to be placed with vendors who sell mostly under $100. BQ Flea only holds fairs at BQ; the regular Sunday market is paused for the season, with special-event Sundays only.
organizers.notes: Record Fair feedback (Amanda): the usual shopper merch price there is about $20-30, so BKSB prices felt high. She also said the fair usually only has music-related vendors.

organizers.name: VendorsMap
organizers.howItWorks: Emails leads for events that "may fit" (for example Staten Island 10/3 and Glendale 8/29).
organizers.notes: Lower priority. Send the relevant ones to the hub.

organizers.name: A&C Super

account.note: No account system. Arranged directly with the owner.

organizers.howItWorks: Williamsburg bakery/cafe. Garrett arranged his own pop-up in their backyard. Fee waived in exchange for keeping about half the space open for guests and donating 15% of that day's profits to North Brooklyn Mutual Aid. The Sep 20 date was rained out and moved to Oct 4. They have another event on Oct 11.
organizers.notes: Garrett floated making it a monthly event.

organizers.name: Bushwick Vendors Market (Monsta House Universe)

account.note: No account. You sign up for each market date with a Google Form. If you are selected, they email you to collect payment. The Instagram post says to scan its QR code (an Arts in Bushwick page about the market) or use the link in their bio to apply.

links.label: Bushwick Vendors Market page (Arts in Bushwick, from the post QR code)

organizers.howItWorks: Only fill out the form when you are ready to pay. Pick your date(s) and table option, describe what you sell, and upload up to 5 photos (they also use them to promote you). If you are selected you get an email to pay. No refunds and no rescheduling under any circumstances. Vendors must arrive by 11:30am to set up, and you must actively promote the event.
organizers.notes: The public name on Instagram is the Bushwick Vendors Market (@bushwickvendorsmarket). The Google Form you pasted was branded Monsta House Universe and has the same address (87 George St), dates and hours, so they are treated as one market. How Monsta House, Bushwick Vendors Market and Arts in Bushwick relate (host, co-organizers) is not stated, so check it. Arts in Bushwick describes the market as a monthly community artists market run with Bushwick Vendors Market. 75% of market proceeds go to the Monsta House community programming.
